reuse.why: Fintegra linking reuses findOrCreateBank and linkBankSyncAccount, but the takeover re-implements unlinkAccount's field reset instead of sharing it, and the Fintegra download and balance branch copy the Akahu ones rather than generalising them.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions is a renamed copy of downloadAkahuTransactions, the Fintegra starting-balance branch repeats the Akahu branch, the holders query is written twice (assertNotLinkedElsewhere and linkBankSyncAccount), and the unlink updateAccount block duplicates unlinkAccount.

placement.why: The link-uniqueness guard is a shared function but is invoked from all six provider wrappers instead of the existing shared linkBankSyncAccount, while the takeover half of the same rule lives inside linkBankSyncAccount, splitting one rule across two layers.

scope.why: Edits are confined to linking, sync and server config for the four requested steps, with a release note; no unrelated changes.

maintainability.why: A guard named assertNotLinkedElsewhere also enforces the closed-account rule and a bypass flag, every new provider must remember to call it and thread replaceExistingLink, and the copied provider code will drift.

bypasses_abstraction.where: accounts/app.ts linkBankSyncAccount: the replaceExistingLink branch resets account fields with its own db.updateAccount instead of going through the existing unlinkAccount logic; the guard is called per provider wrapper rather than in the shared linkBankSyncAccount.

disguised_duplication.where: accounts/sync.ts downloadFintegraTransactions is downloadAkahuTransactions with the server constant and log text renamed; the 'fintegra' branch in processBankSyncDownload repeats the 'akahu' branch with a reformatted reduce.

abstraction_drift.where: assertNotLinkedElsewhere grows a replaceExistingLink flag and a closed-target branch unrelated to its name plus the replace bypass; linkBankSyncAccount gains replaceExistingLink and a branch that re-queries holders; the takeover re-implements unlinkAccount's reset and the holder lookup outside the guard.
